entities.summary: Italian Dominican friar and theologian (1225-1274) whose Summa Theologica synthesized Aristotelian philosophy with Christian theology, creating the most comprehensive philosophical-theological system of the medieval period. His natural law theory, five proofs for God's existence, and just war doctrine continue to influence Catholic teaching and Western philosophy.
